description:
Montichiari’s museum network connects civic collections with historic places in the town. Its art museums include the Lechi Museum and the Antonio and Laura Pasinetti Picture Gallery.

Family gifts have shaped substantial collections of older painting and later artistic work, linking private collecting with the preservation and presentation of the town’s cultural heritage.
